title: Build and submit the iPhone UI refresh
outcome: Freeze WellSpent 0.2.0 (10) from the approved iPhone UI refresh, validate and upload the signed four-component build, attach it to the existing App Store version, and submit it for App Review with accurate metadata.

included: Allocate build 10 while retaining marketing version 0.2.0 across all four components.
Freeze the exact UI-refresh source, regenerate the Xcode project, and run the full validation suite.
Create and inspect an automatically signed archive and App Store distribution export.
Reconcile the three shipping Watch stop-control localization keys required by the release catalog gate.
Keep the Watch widget brand accessibility label verbatim under expanded-localization testing and make vertical-page UI checks tolerate ignored simulator swipes without weakening their assertions.
Upload build 10, wait for App Store processing, attach it to version 0.2.0, update candidate-specific review metadata, and submit for App Review.
Record source, automated, signed-package and external-service evidence without relabeling build 9 artifacts.
excluded: Public release after App Review approval, phased release changes, rating reset, tester invitations or external beta enrollment.

Destructive device actions, legal agreement acceptance, signing identity changes, bundle identifier changes, schema changes, privacy declaration changes or feature work beyond the committed UI refresh.
Replacing accurate existing marketing screenshots unless the attached build makes one materially inaccurate.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A clean exact-source receipt identifies the committed UI refresh as WellSpent 0.2.0 (10), with generated-project parity.
The authoritative full CI suite passes on the frozen build-10 source.
The exact signed archive and App Store distribution export pass four-component inspection.
App Store Connect processes and selects build 10 for version 0.2.0, candidate-specific metadata is accurate, and the exact build is submitted for App Review with manual release retained.
